sv.title: Smällar i Bahrain vid nytt iranskt anfall
sv.summary: Smällar ljuder i Bahrain. Iran säger sig ha attackerat ett USA-kopplat mål i den lilla önationen.

en.title: Explosions in Bahrain after new Iranian attack
en.summary: Explosions are heard in Bahrain. Iran says it has attacked a US-linked target in the small island nation.
